title: ÐMP 1.0 compact-order cancel (advisory)

list_id.description: inscription id of the current list op for the dog (compact-orders §9)

asig.description: compact-orders §7.2 signature by the order key over the canonical cancel

asigs.description: multisig orders: exactly m asig by distinct script keys in key order

items.description: compact-orders §16.10 batch cancel only. Strictly ascending distinct indexes, each less than the batch length. Absent means every item. A single-order cancel MUST omit items.

$comment: No ts: cancels are bound to list_id, not ordered by §6.1. Without asig/asigs the reveal must be signed by the order key (§7.1). Authorization, 'current list', m, and the strictly-ascending items rule are checked by compact-orders §7/§9/§16.10, not by this schema. items is only legal when list_id is a batch inscription id. A cancel is advisory; only moving the dog is authoritative.
